`Handlers.VisualObserverConditions` demanded the typed input ahead of the rule's § 107.205 gate -- the ordering thirteen of the fifteen gated entries took before #93 -- by wrapping the argument back up (`Demand(request.Use, request.EntryId, nameof(request.Use))` for `request.Use`). A caller stating a certificate of waiver of § 107.33 in force and describing nothing else was then refused `ArgumentException` naming `Use` -- `FactRequired`, `MissingInput=Use`, filed under `Outstanding`, which `OperationEvaluation.Outstanding` documents as "everything the caller still owes this engine" -- instead of being declined `OutsideCurrentScope` citing § 107.205 (`docs/decisions/0008-the-waiver-gate-precedes-every-other-demand.md`). So this test, which pins one answer for a waived request, the same across every gated entry, went red on both target frameworks: `Failed!  - Failed:     4, Passed:   739, Skipped:     0, Total:   743` for net10.0 and the same figures for net8.0.
